coordinate_convention: All boxes are [left, top, right, bottom], right and bottom exclusive. Visible boxes use alpha >32. Crop boxes include gutters. Local pivots use crop origin.
generation: Built-in image_gen; one generation per sheet; original two supplied references used for each; normalized final prompts in prompts.json.

wheat_sprig.pivot_description: Near lower-left stem/rivet base; use crop top-left if positioning as an ornament.

notes: The patch sprites include bevel frames; the brass patch includes four rivets. Use panel interiors only if plain materials are required.
Fine grain and gold remain stronger than the requested muted old-game look at full source resolution; downscale for UI use and consider moderate desaturation.
Wheat contains two heads plus a small rivet at the base; it closely follows the original diagonal motif.

loop_crown.pivot_description: Bottom center attachment at crown base; place above ring.

alignment.recommended: Crop ring to its 608 square; crop glass to its 560 square; display both at the same normalized square dimensions and center pivot. Fine tune glass scale ~1% if needed.
alignment.ring_note: Outer meaningful-alpha silhouette is 584 by 580 (0.7% deviation from circle); crop is square.
alignment.glass_alpha: Central 220x220 region mean alpha 4.96/255; center sample RGBA [255,255,255,2]. It is a transparent glass layer, not an opaque white disk.

holder_bracket.notes: Generator produced two straps connected by a right-side spine. For a single strap use the top band crop below.

holder_single_band_optional.notes: Top band only, excluding lower bracket; right-side spine may leave a small endpoint below rivet.

alignment.liquid_mask_recommendation: Constrain liquid within central opening approximately x=67..174 and y=111..670 of normalized tube crop, with rounded lower end reaching y~704. Inspect art against the final fill before shipping.
alignment.cork_recommendation: Scale cork crop to around 206 pixels wide on the 256-wide normalized tube canvas; place its bottom near mouth y=47. Rotate only the whole assembled vial around shared center.
alignment.back_alpha: Inner body mean alpha 0.007/255; center sample alpha 0.
alignment.front_alpha: Inner body mean alpha 4.09/255; center sample alpha 1.

notes: No liquid and no text in vial sheet.

The back layer includes both edge walls and a complete mouth ellipse; front layer includes another mouth and bottom. Stack aligned to avoid doubled edges, and reduce front layer opacity if thick glass becomes too strong.
Cork has finer texture than the requested low-frequency finish at source resolution.
